provenance: Independently authored contrastive equivalents of the user-proposed examples. No example is a normalized exact-text match to a canonical validation or test outcome.
design_note: The examples emphasize unusual subgroup-to-label boundaries while preserving the held-out evaluation.

examples.text: Mortality from any cause over follow-up
Delivery before 37 completed weeks of gestation
Death attributable to a cardiac cause
Technical failure of the operative procedure
Stopping assigned treatment because of harmful effects
Vertebral fracture identified on spinal imaging
Peripheral oxygen saturation under the prespecified 95% threshold
Participants with one or more serious harmful events
Newly diagnosed lower respiratory tract infection
Absence of improvement in clinical status
Proportion attaining the prespecified glycated haemoglobin goal
